candidate.title: Bulk approval of pending requests by contact group
candidate.applicability: Use when approving pending payment or similar requests limited to people identified by contact relationship.
procedure: Inspect API descriptions and endpoint docs before acting; confirm login, listing, filtering, approval, and verification parameters.
Authenticate to each required service and retain the returned access token.
Identify targets from a contact source by relationship labels; enumerate relationship values first if available.
Fetch contacts for each needed relationship with pagination, using maximum page size until a short or empty page.
Fetch pending received requests with status filtering and pagination; collect all pages before deciding.
Build a target identifier set from contact fields, normalize case, and match sender identifiers.
Check balance or funding source if approvals debit funds; omit optional funding identifiers unless required.
Approve selected requests individually and record responses.
Re-query pending requests with the same filters and confirm no target requests remain.
pitfalls: Do not approve requests outside the requested relationship set.
Do not assume one page contains all records.
Do not rely on display names alone when stable identifiers exist.
Do not consider approvals complete without response checks and a follow-up query.
